summary: Six-phase plan written to plans/01_development-marker.md, validated by validate-artifact.sh. Applies the orchestrator scope ruling verbatim: file_scope widened by exactly one file (.github/scripts/unstable_watch_classify.py), recorded with reasoning in a Scope Decisions section; unstable-watch.yml, release.yml, and oracle/conftest.py explicitly NOT edited. The observability design was reshaped so it lands with zero YAML dependency: the classifier gains an optional third JUnit input (/tmp/watch-development.xml) that no workflow step produces today, so DEV_STATUS classification, record schema, and pass-trend reporting are fully implemented and unit-tested here while being inert in production. The deferred /spawn candidate is the workflow step that would produce that file, plus the test_unstable_deselection_wiring.py assertion (currently requiring exactly two '-m unstable' matches in unstable-watch.yml) that a third step would invalidate. Rejected the alternative one-line '-m "unstable or development"' widening because it requires a hand-maintained node-id registry that drifts against the actual decorators. Phases: (1) pyproject marker registration incl. the deliberate oracle-conftest non-mirroring note, (2) six -m edits + in-place extension of the deselection contract test, atomic-batch since the extended test is red until all drivers land, (3) DEV_STATUS classification path never touching any_new/any_failure/exit code, (4) pass-rate trend reporting reusing fetch_past_classifications via a defaulted field selector, (5) TESTING_GUIDE.md 8.14 kept section-scoped to avoid the task 176 collision, (6) full-gate verification plus a required summary record of all four deferred/flagged omissions. Waves: [1,3] -> [2,4] -> [5] -> [6]; wave 1 is territory-disjoint.
